clue.text: Description of big effort in situation with no one at work?

definitions.meaning: an ... effort is one using every ounce of strength

definitions.text: situation with no one at work?
definitions.meaning: when all the workers are out, on strike, nobody is at work

explanation.surface: A puzzling account of a huge effort made in a workplace that stands empty.
explanation.definitionFit: All-out describes total, maximum exertion, and 'all out' is also a strike call emptying the workplace.

clue.text: Exodus was one of these with surging Red Sea put asunder finally

indicators.note: surging waters tumble and churn, so these letters are tossed into a new order

parts.note: taken as written as anagram fodder

indicators.note: finally picks only the closing letter of the word asunder

explanation.surface: The Exodus story: the Israelites leave as the Red Sea is parted and its waters surge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surging' scrambles REDSEAPUT plus R, the last letter of 'asunder' picked by 'finally'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Exodus was the Israelites' going out from Egypt, a mass leaving, so it is one example of such leavings.

clue.text: Sound a group of singers had picked up

indicators.note: Sound at the start tells us the words are to be heard rather than read

parts.note: a group of singers is a choir; 'had' shortens to 'd, giving 'a choir'd'

explanation.surface: Something a choir has heard and absorbed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A choir'd' (a choir had) is spoken the same as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To acquire something is to get or pick it up, as with a habit or a skill.

clue.text: See returning ambassador dashing around

indicators.note: around says the dashing word sits around the other piece

parts.note: a dashing, daring person is bold

indicators.note: returning means the ambassador's letters are read backwards

parts.note: HE is His (or Her) Excellency, the title of an ambassador

explanation.surface: Look: an ambassador coming home and rushing about.
explanation.walkthrough: HE is the crossword's usual ambassador, from His Excellency; 'returning' reverses it and 'around' wraps the dashing word about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Behold is an old-fashioned command to look or observe, a synonym for see.

clue.text: Sport and dance curtailed when leg gets crushed

indicators.note: the leg gets crushed, squeezed in between the letters of the other piece
curtailed means the dance's tail, its last letter, is cut off

parts.note: ballet is a form of dance
gam is slang for a leg, especially a shapely one

explanation.surface: A dancer's routine is cut short after an injury that crushes a leg.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curtailed' loses the dance's last letter; 'gets crushed' squeezes the slang leg into what remains. 'Sport' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballgame is any sport played with a ball, especially baseball in American use.

clue.text: Female promiscuity of blonde bombshell with attempt to cut out wife

indicators.note: to cut out tells us a letter must be removed from the film star's name

parts.note: Jean Harlow, the 1930s Hollywood star, was the original 'blonde bombshell'
an attempt is a try

explanation.surface: A tale of a glamorous blonde's loose behaviour and an attempt to remove a wife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to cut out wife' drops W from HARLOW, leaving HARLO.
explanation.definitionFit: Harlotry is the behaviour of a harlot, an old word for a prostitute or wanton woman.

clue.text: The fellow with right awkward clues — a labouring individual

parts.note: the fellow is he

indicators.note: awkward suggests something ungainly and out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man with a right to complain about clumsy clues, toiling away.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek hero was set twelve famous labours, so he is the labouring individual par excellence.

clue.text: Reluctant man with bad wife, little husband

parts.note: in Genesis Lot's wife disobeyed and looked back at Sodom, becoming a pillar of salt
H is the short form of husband

explanation.surface: A man stuck with a bad wife and a small husband, unwilling.
explanation.definitionFit: Loth is a spelling of loath, meaning unwilling or disinclined.

clue.text: Sovereign's beginning to appear with piece of regalia for someone in Lusatia

indicators.note: beginning picks the opening letter of the word Sovereign's

parts.note: the orb is part of the crown jewels carried by a monarch

explanation.surface: A monarch first appearing holding the orb before a subject in a central European region.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sorbs are a Slavic people of Lusatia, in eastern Germany, so a Sorb is one inhabitant there.

clue.text: Passages in ancient Greek city by lake

parts.note: Argos is an ancient city in the Peloponnese

explanation.surface: Travel routes in an old Greek city beside a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: Largos are slow musical movements or sections, the musical sense of passages.

clue.text: In storm secure a support

indicators.note: secure means the storm word holds the other letter safely inside it

parts.note: bluster is a stormy, blowing wind, or to rage like one

explanation.surface: During a storm, fasten down a prop.
explanation.definitionFit: A baluster is a short pillar holding up a handrail, a kind of upright support.

clue.text: Good entertainer, American guy who gets in the spirit? The opposite!

definitions.text: who gets in the spirit? The opposite!

parts.note: a host entertains guests
buster is an American form of address to a man

explanation.surface: A good performer, an American who really enters into the spirit of things.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition flips 'gets in the spirit': rather than taking a spirit in, this person gets spirits out.
explanation.definitionFit: A ghostbuster drives ghosts away, the opposite of welcoming a spirit in.

clue.text: Menials working for Conservative female

definitions.note: a plural noun for the people who make up this one collective group

parts.note: someone working for a boss is under them
a lass is a girl or young woman

explanation.surface: Servants employed by a woman who votes Tory.
explanation.definitionFit: The underclass is the lowest social stratum, doing the humblest, most poorly paid jobs.

clue.text: Regular visitors pretty in colours

indicators.note: in places the 'pretty' piece inside the colours word

parts.note: hues are colours
pretty, as in 'pretty good', means rather or a bit

explanation.surface: Frequent guests looking attractive in bright clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pretty' here is the adverb (rather), not the adjective, giving A BIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Habitués are people who frequent a particular place, such as a bar's regulars.

clue.text: Bad person above all others joins up

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the letters are read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: the one above all others is at the top
knits means joins, as broken bones knit together

explanation.surface: A rotten character, ranked above everyone else, signing up.
explanation.definitionFit: Stinkpot is an informal insult for a contemptible or nasty person.

clue.text: Villainous knight brings extra fear, we hear

indicators.note: we hear says the answer is spoken like the preceding words

parts.note: extra fear is more dread

explanation.surface: A wicked knight arrives, bringing added terror.
explanation.definitionFit: In Arthurian legend Mordred betrays King Arthur and fights him at Camlann.

clue.text: Disturbing judgement that's very loudly introduced

indicators.note: introduced means the music marking is put into the judgement word

parts.note: a ruling is a judgement
FF, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: An upsetting court verdict announced at full volume.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruffling feathers means upsetting or agitating someone.

clue.text: Plan once again coming from socialist platform?

parts.note: red is a common term for a socialist or communist
a raft is a floating platform

explanation.surface: A revised manifesto produced by a left-wing party platform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'platform' looks political, but here it is a floating one.
explanation.definitionFit: To redraft is to draw up a plan or document again in a new version.

clue.text: Front office for countryside activity

parts.note: fore means the front, as in to the fore
a station is a post or position, an office held

explanation.surface: A front office handling business for rural affairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Forestation is the planting of trees to establish woodland on rural land.

clue.text: Curved shapes in pollarded trees

indicators.note: a pollarded tree has its top lopped off, so the first letter goes

parts.note: larches are coniferous trees

explanation.surface: Bowed forms seen among trees cut back hard.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry the top of the word is its first letter, which 'pollarded' removes.
explanation.definitionFit: Arches are curved structures or forms, like a bridge span or a raised eyebrow.

clue.text: A dog's dinner?

definitions.meaning: a dog, the Chinese breed with a blue-black tongue
slang for food or a meal

explanation.surface: A dog's dinner is British slang for a mess, and the clue asks about one.
explanation.definitionFit: Chow is both a breed of dog and informal slang for food.

clue.text: A blade used by crew avoiding river animal

indicators.note: avoiding means the river letter is kept out of the phrase

parts.note: an oar is a blade used by a rowing crew; 'A' becomes 'an'

explanation.surface: A rowing crew's oar kept away from the river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'avoiding' drops the R of AN OAR.
explanation.definitionFit: The anoa is a small wild buffalo of Sulawesi, a crossword-favourite beast.

clue.text: Respect pop singer's shown for old city, a capital

indicators.note: shown for means the singer appears in place of the city

parts.note: to honour is to respect
Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city
Lulu is a Scottish pop singer famous since the 1960s

explanation.surface: A singer is shown deference in place of an ancient town, as a capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shown for' replaces UR in HONOUR with LULU.
explanation.definitionFit: Honolulu is the capital city of the US state of Hawaii.

clue.text: Grab fruit that's delicious except for five 'off' bits

indicators.note: five 'off' bits says five letters, at the end, are taken away

parts.note: scrumptious means delicious

explanation.surface: Steal some fruit that is tasty apart from five rotten pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'except for five off bits' drops the last five letters TIOUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrumping is British slang for stealing apples from an orchard.

clue.text: Facing nasty snakes you and I may show timidity

indicators.note: Facing puts the 'you and I' word in front of the rest

parts.note: you and I together are we

indicators.note: nasty suggests something twisted, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Confronting vicious snakes, we might show we are afraid.
explanation.definitionFit: Weakness is lack of strength or nerve, and timidity is a kind of that lack of courage.

clue.text: Bullies offering bribes?

definitions.meaning: to get at a witness is to bribe or corrupt them

explanation.surface: Thugs who pay people off.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb gets at means both to pick on someone and to suborn them by bribery.
